tools.description: Report Remote MCP gateway and tool readiness. This does not probe live Factor Mining, embedding, dedup, or every downstream dependency.
tools.name: fm_status
tools.title: Factor Mining Status

tools.description: Return FM-owned public tasks with each task's authoritative canonical category and structured research context. This is the classification reference to consult before fm_custom_sess.
tools.name: fm_list_tasks
tools.title: Factor Mining List Tasks

tools.description: Return the server-provided plugin.py construction contract. For a normal custom-factor workflow, after fm_status call with {} to read the global construction/data-column contract, select only exact returned data-column names, call fm_custom_sess, then call again with only the returned session_id. Treat that scoped contract as authoritative when writing and validating plugin.py. Do not send a hand-built custom task_payload or multiple selectors in this workflow. Do not retry an identical non-retryable request or silently change the user's research mechanism after a non-retryable validation error. For public tasks, use one exact task_id or the created session_id.
tools.name: fm_get_contract
tools.title: Factor Mining Get Contract

tools.description: Create a Factor Mining session from a public task.
tools.name: fm_task_session
tools.title: Factor Mining Task Session

tools.description: Create a custom Factor Mining session with the single canonical flat payload. allowed_data must contain exact column names returned by the immediately preceding global fm_get_contract call with {}.
tools.name: fm_custom_sess
tools.title: Factor Mining Custom Session

tools.description: Validate inline Factor Mining plugin Python source. Use session_id for the normal public or custom workflow; session_id, task_id, task_payload and direct allowed_data are mutually exclusive validation contexts.

plugin_source.description: Inline Factor Mining plugin Python source.

tools.name: fm_validate
tools.title: Factor Mining Validate

tools.description: Return Factor Mining research-memory context. Call with session_id after session creation to inspect task_memory_pressure. Call again with a concrete draft that includes a valid plugin source and/or non-empty description or formula before upload to inspect draft_duplicate_risk. The legacy duplicate_risk field is compatibility-only; use the mode-specific fields for decisions.
tools.name: fm_dedup_context
tools.title: Factor Mining Dedup Context

tools.description: Upload inline plugin source, submit a backtest, and wait within the configured backend budget. The session contract supplies fwd_period; do not send a separate horizon.

job_id.description: Bare backtest job id from run.run_id or run.job_ids[].

tools.name: fm_window_cards
tools.title: Factor Mining Window Cards

job_id.description: Bare backtest job id from run.run_id or run.job_ids[].

tools.name: fm_chart_data
tools.title: Factor Mining Chart Data

tools.title: Factor Mining Run Source

tools.description: Optional Factor chart PNG export after fm_window_cards. Pass png_artifacts[].source_name as name. It returns a short-lived Remote MCP URL, not S3/internal/presigned URLs. Save only when the user requests an export, verify bytes/md5, then avoid printing or persisting the URL. Analysis uses server evidence instead.

job_id.description: Bare backtest job id from run.run_id or run.job_ids[].

name.description: Exact PNG source_name returned by fm_window_cards.

tools.name: fm_png_ticket
tools.title: Factor Mining Png Ticket

tools.description: Optional export after a backtest reaches terminal state: request the raw signal parquet artifact. Pass name=step4/signal_raw.parquet when provided. Download the returned short-lived Remote MCP URL to signal_raw.parquet, verify size_bytes and sha256_hex, then avoid printing or persisting the URL. Missing raw parquet should be recorded as unavailable, not treated as a failed run. Do not use local parquet or a Python runtime as analysis evidence.

job_id.description: Bare backtest job id from run.run_id or run.job_ids[].

name.description: Raw signal artifact name. Use step4/signal_raw.parquet.

tools.name: fm_raw_ticket
tools.title: Factor Mining Raw Ticket

tools.description: Create a short-lived single-use URL for the immutable Factor Result Bundle as an optional export. Analysis uses fm_window_cards, fm_chart_data, and fm_run_source instead. Use fm_bundle_chunk automatically if the export URL cannot be downloaded.
tools.name: fm_bundle_ticket
tools.title: Factor Mining Bundle Ticket

tools.description: Bounded fallback for an explicitly requested Factor Result Bundle export. It is not an analysis evidence path. Start at offset 0, use at most 262144 bytes, and follow validated next_offset for the same snapshot_revision.
tools.name: fm_bundle_chunk
tools.title: Factor Mining Bundle Chunk

tools.description: Optional Factor chart PNG export fallback after fm_window_cards when a download ticket is unavailable or fails. Pass png_artifacts[].source_name as name. Loop offset=0, limit<=262144: decode content_b64, append bytes, then continue with next_offset until next_offset is null. Verify size_bytes and md5_hex when possible. Do not use this for numerical analysis.

job_id.description: Bare backtest job id from run.run_id or run.job_ids[].

name.description: Exact PNG source_name returned by fm_window_cards.

tools.title: Factor Mining Png Chunk

tools.description: List caller-owned reusable Factor Mining factor families with compact safe summaries; this is not the Strategy eligible/selectable factor pool. Omit page_size unless pagination is needed; when present it must be an integer from 1 through 20. A failed call is an error, not an empty list: claim zero factors only when a successful response contains an empty items array. After an error, stop this read workflow and do not call fm_get_history as a fallback. Use sb_list_eligible for bare available/eligible/selectable-factor or Strategy-pool requests, and do not call both lists for those requests.
tools.name: fm_list_factors
tools.title: Factor Mining List Factors

tools.description: Read one caller-owned reusable Factor Mining factor family's summary, branches, versions, or run metadata. Use only an exact factor_id returned by a successful fm_list_factors response for the current caller. Never call after a list error. Never substitute a backtest run_id, job_id, plugin_id, session_id, PB intake_result.factor.factor_id, Strategy top-level compatibility selector, Strategy admission ID, or any locally cached ID. Summary has no selectors or pagination; the input schema expresses the valid selector/pagination combinations for every view.
